summary: In this brief, Jeanne Bliss provocatively asks how clearly an organization defines the memories it intends customers to carry. The message emphasizes identifying the critical touchpoints and intersection points that shape a personal bond between customers and a small business owner, highlighting the need for cross-functional alignment within the organization. By considering whether five people across the company can articulate those moments, the talk underscores that memorable customer experiences hinge on shared understanding of which interactions matter most and how to deliver them consistently.
title: Clarify the Memories You Deliver: Mapping Critical Touchpoints for Personal Bonds in Small Businesses
